name: Power Ring
lore: Resized twice: once for a quarry foreman, once for the man who beat him.

name: Magic Ring
lore: Ansel, the ring hums while I study. Tell me that's normal. Love, Mira.

name: Speed Ring
lore: Won at a duel the witnesses called mercifully short.

name: Shield Ring
lore: Cast from a shield-boss that outlived the three men who carried it.

name: Barrier Ring
lore: Inside the band, in a child's letters: NO FIRE ON PAPA.

name: Skill Ring
lore: Pawn ticket still tied on: one ring, fletcher's, redeem by spring. Unredeemed.

name: Goddess Icon
lore: Thumbed blank by the dying. The goddess's name was not forgotten; it was spent.

name: Seraph Robe
lore: Temple sisters sewed it for a son they never had. It fits whoever needs it.

name: Boots
lore: Resoled four times. The courier inside them was never caught, or paid.

name: Delphi Shield
lore: Sky legion issue. The archers have a word for riders without one: supper.

name: Veteran's Crest
lore: Awarded after twenty battles. Awarded: 61. Still worn at discharge: 4.

name: Wrath Band
lore: The berserk school's leash, worn backward: it loosens only once you bleed.

name: Counter Seal
lore: Pressed in the wax: ONE AT A TIME, GENTLEMEN. The dueling halls' first rule.

name: Pursuit Ring
lore: Hunter's saying: the hare is faster, but the hare is also more tired.

name: Nullify Ring
lore: Engraved with every slayer-rune, each one scored out by the same angry hand.

name: Life Ring
lore: Favors the unscathed. Its owners tended to be either very good or very new.

name: Forest Charm
lore: Plaited by a warden's daughter from birch and hair. The trees know her knot.

name: Blood Gem
lore: Eases an art's blood-price. The gem-cutter's price, it does not ease at all.

name: Vampire's Bloodshard
lore: Chipped from something dug up in the fens. It was still warm. It still is.

name: Soothing Stone
lore: A river stone his mother warmed for his cot. It never quite cooled again.

name: Phoenix Brooch
lore: His wife pinned it on him at the gate. Twice he fell, and twice it heard her.

name: Recoil Guard
lore: Strap it tight. Swing big. Then stand there and take it like it was your idea.

name: Bounty Hunter's Mark
lore: Guild brand, notched per head. The guild pays; the guild never asks whose.

name: Moontide Amulet
lore: Tide-silver. Some nights it sings, some it sulks; its owner learned to count.

name: Gambler's Coin
lore: 'Heads or tails?' 'Yes.' Last words of its previous owner, more or less.

name: Vanguard Crest
lore: Struck for those who held ground alone. Most are presented to the family.

name: Diamond Medallion
lore: Caravan guards swear by it: the more knives around you, the harder it shines.

name: Hunter's Cloak
lore: Deep-wood families hand it down with the bow. Stand still in it and be a tree.

name: Duelist's Glove
lore: Dueling hall etiquette: one glove thrown, one opponent, no seconds, no help.

name: Warding Charm
lore: A novice's first ward, knotted too tight to undo. Hexes can't find the ends.

name: Mentor's Band
lore: Old Hessa taught forty recruits in it. Thirty-one lived. She called it a good year.

name: Mercury Sandals
lore: Winged heels out of an old myth. The myth leaves out the archers.

name: Phalanx Band
lore: Issued in pairs. If you find one alone, don't ask the quartermaster why.
